decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension is used.

Condition : 4 - REASON FOR APPROVAL

IT IS CONSIDERED THAT THE PROPOSED CONVERSION OF A STUDY AND STORE IN TO A GARAGE, BECAUSE OF ITS POSITION, DESIGN AND APPAERANCE, WOULD BE ACCEPTABLE HAVING DUE REGARD FOR THE SITE CHARACTERISTICS OF NO.8 ELIZABETH  WAY AND COMPLEMENTARY TO THE VISUAL AMENITY OF THE LOCALITY AND THE CONSERVATION AREA , AND WOULD NOT BE DETRIMENTAL TO THE AMENITIES OF THE  ADJACENT NEIGHBOURING PROPERTIES. ON BALANCE THE DEVELOPMENT IS CONSIDERED ACCEPTABLE AND WOULD BE IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE ADOPTED UDP POLICIES ENV-B.1.1(NEW DEVELOPMENT), ENV-B.2.2 (CONSERVATION AREAS), H.4.1 (HOUSING STANDARDS AND GUIDELINES) H.6.4 (EXTENSIONS AND ALTERATIONS), THE SUPPLEMENTARY AND RESIDENTIAL EXTENSIONS GUIDELINES OF THE LONDON BOROUGH OF HOUNSLOW UDP, ADOPTED (DECEMBER 2003.). IT IS CONSIDERED THAT WHERE THE DEVELOPMENT IS NOT COMPLIANT THERE ARE NO UNDUE ADVERSE EFFECTS RESULTING FROM THIS.
description: Conversion of existing study and sotrey  to a garage.
